about_the_game:
Step into the high heels of a nightclub hostess and defend your territory in an over-the-top third-person zombie shooter. When the undead crash the party, it is time to grab your weapon and show them who is boss.

Battle through waves of increasingly deadly zombies in a vibrant, neon-lit nightclub setting. Start with a basic pistol, earn score for each kill, and use it to purchase powerful new weapons or unlock fresh areas of the map. Survive round after round, upgrade your loadout, and reclaim your club.

Whether you are fighting solo or partying up with friends in multiplayer, teamwork and firepower are your keys to survival.

Defeating invaders earns youscore, which can be spent on upgrading your arsenal. Invest in powerful weapons to ramp up your firepower, allowing you to eliminate waves of undead more efficiently. The stronger your gear, the better your chances of survival!

Exterminate the undeads and reclaim your territory— stay aware of your surroundings, fight with everything you have got, and push back the horde. Only the strongest will survive!

Never underestimate the undeads. They are faster, stronger, and deadlier than they seem. Keep moving or you might be the next to bite the dust!

Team up with your allies, strength lies in numbers! Watch each other’s backs, strategize together, and increase your chances of survival against the zombies.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains intense and stylized violence, featuring battles against hordes of zombies. The main characters are nightclub dancers wearing revealing outfits, engaged in bloody combat against non-human enemies.

The game includes:

Graphic violence: brutal fights against zombies using melee and firearms, with blood effects and dismemberment.

Suggestive content: female characters dressed in revealing outfits, but no explicit nudity or sexual scenes.

This game does not contain depictions of sexual assault, non-consensual relationships, self-harm, or drug abuse.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64 20H2
  • Processor: Intel i5-3570 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 32 GB available space

short_description: Fight off endless waves of undead as a nightclub hostess in this stylish third-person shooter. Earn points, buy better weapons, unlock new areas, and survive as long as possible. Solo or with friends, take back your club, one zombie at a time in heels and with attitude.
